name: Tome of Divinity
summary: In Ironforge, young dwarven paladins begin a rite of passage beyond basic martial training. Brandur Ironhammer sends them upstairs in the Hall of Mysteries to seek Tiza Battleforge and take up the deeper duties and sacred vows of the Holy Light.

sections.title: The Call to the High Seat
sections.body: Young paladins first defend Anvilmar and Kharanos from troggs and frost trolls. When their martial discipline is proven, Brandur Ironhammer, their paladin trainer in Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries, sends them upstairs for guidance. Senior paladins there prepare initiates for the order's spiritual duties.

sections.title: Guidance from Tiza Battleforge
sections.body: Tiza Battleforge is a revered paladin among Ironforge's dwarves. She teaches initiates the burdens of the Light beyond swordplay and hammer blows: compassion, justice, and self-sacrifice. Seeking her begins formal study of the Tome of Divinity, a sacred path toward the power to resurrect the fallen.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: Brandur Ironhammer directs young dwarven paladins from their trainer to senior paladin Tiza Battleforge in Ironforge. This begins the trials required to study the Tome of Divinity and gain the power of spiritual resurrection.

Brandur Ironhammer trains dwarven paladins in the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge's Mystic Ward. He oversees young paladins and sends promising initiates upstairs to Tiza Battleforge when they are ready for greater sacred duties.
Tiza Battleforge is a respected veteran paladin upstairs in Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries. She teaches younger paladins what the Holy Light demands beyond martial skill.

faq.q: Where does this quest lead next?
faq.answer: Speaking with Tiza Battleforge begins the Tome of Divinity trials. They test a paladin's devotion, mercy, and willingness to protect and restore life in service to the Light.

faq.q: Why must dwarven paladins seek out the Tome of Divinity?
faq.answer: A paladin must understand selflessness and spiritual duty to return a fallen ally to life. The Tome of Divinity guides initiates through formal lessons and tests of faith needed to channel such potent holy power.

faq.q: Do humans receive this same instruction in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Human paladins follow a parallel path through the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind. Brandur Ironhammer's specific summons to Tiza Battleforge is for dwarves training in Ironforge.

angles.text: As a paladin, you move from martial drills toward the spiritual duties of the Holy Light. The trials lead toward the power of Redemption.
As a dwarf, you join the Holy Light's devotion with Khaz Modan's traditions of duty and brotherhood. You answer the call in Ironforge's mountain halls.
